labels.label: excluded

evidence.quote: Patients must have recurrent or persistent disease
Patients must have a HER2 amplified solid tumor except breast cancer.
Patients must have measurable disease based on RECIST 1.1

labels.note: HER2-amplified recurrent solid tumor basket; patient has newly upgraded, untreated localized prostate cancer.

labels.label: possibly

evidence.quote: Be diagnosed with Stage I-IV prostate cancer without metastases to bone
Be starting ADT or have received their first ADT treatment in the past 6 months
Have a total serum vitamin D between 10 and 32 ng/ml

labels.note: Fits localized disease; depends on whether he starts ADT (only suggested) and on vitamin D level.

labels.label: eligible

evidence.quote: Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) performance status ≤ 2
Prior definitive treatment of prostate cancer
Metastatic disease by conventional or molecular imaging

labels.note: Gleason 3+4, PSA 11, localized, untreated, ECOG 2: intermediate-risk SABR candidate; gland volume unknown.
